name: Combo Momentum
description: Boosts ATK the longer a combo continues without missing a hit.

name: Finisher Focus
description: Boosts DMG Cap of combo finishers.

name: Blade Precision
description: Boosts ATK of normal attacks.

name: Relentless Edge
description: Boosts DMG Cap the longer a combo continues without missing a hit.

name: Overcharge
description: Charged attacks gain a stacking ATK boost while charging.

name: Flowing Strikes
description: Shortens the time between combo finishers.

name: Masterful Form
description: Boosts ATK based on combo count, up to a cap.

name: Peak Condition
description: Grants a large ATK and DMG Cap boost upon reaching max combo momentum.

name: Unbroken Chain
description: Combo momentum no longer resets from taking damage.

name: Finishing Blow
description: Combo finishers have a chance to deal bonus Supplementary DMG.

name: Captain's Focus
description: Boosts DMG Cap of Skybound Arts.

name: Healing Vigor
description: Using a healing skill grants the party a temporary ATK boost.

name: Restorative Strike
description: Normal attacks have a small chance to restore HP to the party.

name: Tactical Support
description: Boosts the potency of support skills.

name: Healer's Edge
description: Using a healing skill also grants the party a temporary DMG Cap boost.

name: Shared Vitality
description: Boosts healing amount to allies with low HP.

name: Quick Recovery
description: Shortens the cooldown of healing skills.

name: Rally Cry
description: Using a support skill grants nearby allies a brief ATK boost.

name: Guardian's Blessing
description: Using a healing skill grants the party a small Shield.

name: Second Wind
description: Automatically triggers a healing effect when an ally's HP drops critically low (once per quest).

name: United Front
description: Boosts ATK and DEF to all allies while grouped together.

name: Lifebound Surge
description: Healing skills grant a stacking ATK and DMG Cap boost for a short time.

name: Charisma
description: Taking damage in place of an ally protected by Substitute grants a stacking Charisma effect (max lvl 5), boosting DEF per level.

name: Guardian's Resolve
description: Boosts DEF while protecting an ally with Substitute.

name: Steadfast
description: Reduces damage taken while Substitute is active.

name: Charisma+
description: Charisma also boosts damage dealt per effect level.

name: Swift Recovery
description: Taking damage in place of an ally shortens skill cooldowns.

name: Bulwark
description: Boosts maximum HP while Substitute is active.

name: Protector's Instinct
description: Extends the duration of Substitute.

name: Party Shield
description: Substitute grants a DMG Cap boost to the entire party.

name: Unbreakable
description: Grants Stout Heart while protecting an ally.

name: Last Stand
description: Survive a lethal hit while Substitute is active (limited uses).

name: Rallying Presence
description: Boosts ATK to nearby allies while Substitute is active.
